scope: Small-cover physical endpoint seating, release and half-second retention. Not proof of robot pickup, insertion access, or autonomous task success.
method: Deterministic regrading of preserved real physical probe data using pose-window stability and intermittent contact evidence; original native outcomes remain unchanged.

negatives.reason: wrong depth, radial position, face direction and absent support

negative_scope_note: Historical negatives used the same geometry/scale with earlier solver settings. They validate rejection of measured wrong endpoint states, not current-solver failure frequencies. Stability is deliberately assumed true only to prove geometric rejection independently; no missing physical stability evidence is asserted.

stability.contact: Real support observed within this same window; no unbounded historical persistence
stability.penetration: Maximum over the window, not only final sample
